rows.note: Use 偷睇 as the all-purpose everyday expression for taking a quick, usually furtive look.

example.english: I had a peep at the photo on his phone while he wasn't looking.
example.traditional: 我趁佢唔為意偷睇咗手機入面張相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 can3 keoi5 m4 wai4 ji3 tau1 tai2 zo2 sau2 gei1 jap6 min6 zoeng1 soeng2

rows.note: Use 𥊙 for the specifically Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to take a quick peek.

example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zong1 ngo5 go3 doi2 aa3

rows.note: Use 聲 for the faint sound or utterance meant in expressions such as “not a peep.”

example.english: With everyone looking at me, I was too nervous to make a peep.
example.traditional: 成班人望住我，我緊張到一聲都唔敢出。
example.jyutping: sing4 baan1 jan4 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 ngo5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 jat1 seng1 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1
